verdict.rationale: iTerm2 ships a Python scripting API that the GitHub README describes as 'full automation and customization,' covering custom status bar components, triggers, menu items and new features. It also has AppleScript support for launching sessions, tabs and windows with profiles. A community user independently says the Python API 'lets you touch pretty much everything,' which supports broad coverage of what the UI can do. Missing for 10: no documented mapping showing every UI feature (settings, find, paste history, instant replay, AI chat, browser profiles) is reachable through the API, and the API's scope is not explicitly documented against the UI.
